basic_info.description: First time on the market! Step into style and comfort in this completely renovated, light-filled, home nestled in the desirable Sunset neighborhood — thoughtfully updated for modern living.  Enter through a secure front door into a spacious, open-concept layout featuring a fully remodeled kitchen with elegant cabinetry, marble countertops, and stainless steel appliances. The kitchen flows seamlessly into expansive living and dining areas, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining.  Gleaming laminate wood floors, fresh paint, a striking fireplace, two generous bedrooms, and an updated full bath complete the main level. Downstairs, you'll find a one-car garage and access to a large backyard — a blank canvas with endless potential for your dream garden or outdoor retreat.  Located on a quiet, well-kept block near Golden Gate Park and close to shops and eateries of Irving Street. Enjoy easy access to the San Francisco Zoo, museums, and more. With a high Walk Score of 83 and excellent public transit nearby, this move-in-ready gem offers the perfect balance of serenity and vibrant city living. Hurry this opportunity won't last long!
